text.p: McDonald's Corp said Thursday it will launch a promotion tied to Walt Disney Co's release of the animated film "Hercules."

The promotion, which features special Happy Meal toys and premiums and Hercules-themed packaging and in-restaurant decor, will run from June 20 through July 24. The film is scheduled to open nationwide June 27.
The promotion is part of the exclusive, 10-year marketing alliance between McDonald's and Disney.
"It's another example of the type of innovative customer event made possible by the McDonald's/Disney partnership," Brad Ball, McDonald's senior vice president of marketing, said in a statement.

As part of the promotion, McDonald's Happy Meals for children will feature 10 toy characters from the film. Two different Hercules toys will be available each week for five weeks at participating restaurants while supplies last.
McDonald's also will sell six Hercules-themed plates featuring characters from the film for $1.99 with the purchase of a Happy Meal or large sandwich.
